fullText.simplified:
五、大白

    饭饭在山洞里发现了小白。小白睡在地上，大雕睡在他旁边的大石头上。
    “小白……小白……”饭饭小声地叫，小白像是没听到。
    大雕突然动了一下，然后站了起来。被发现了吗？饭饭的心飞快地跳了起来。他一动不动地看着大雕，但大雕没有往他这边看。真好，大雕没有发现他。
    “晚饭时间到了。”大雕说。
    他看了看地上的小白，然后跳下石头，对着小白的腿，咬了一口。
    “啊！”小白疼得大叫一声。
    大雕笑了：“我和你玩呢，又不是真的吃你，别害怕。”
    “我不想和你玩，你吃了我吧，我不害怕。”小白说。
    “你不害怕？我不信。以前大白被我抓住的时候，你是多害怕啊，你不记得了吗？”
    小白不说话了。饭饭看到他的腿、尾巴、头和身体都被咬过。他一定很疼，所以不能动了。
    “你记得。那你还记得我的翅膀为什么一边大一边小吗？”大雕动了动翅膀。
    饭饭看清楚了，大雕的翅膀真的一边大一边小，左边的大一点儿，右边的小一点儿。但如果不认真看，是很难发现的。
    小白还是不说话，但他笑了，笑得很大声。
    “都是因为你！两年前你咬在我右边翅膀上的那一口，让我在家休息了两个月。如果没有我爸爸，我可能到今天都还不能飞呢。”大雕说。
    “我为什么要咬你？你不知道吗？”小白问。
    大雕笑着说：“真的要我说吗？因为我抓了大白，因为我吃了他啊！”
    小白的头动了一下，饭饭看到了他的眼睛。
    他的眼睛是红色的，那里面有生气，也有难过。
fullText.traditional:
五、大白

    飯飯在山洞裡發現了小白。小白睡在地上，大鵰睡在他旁邊的大石頭上。
    “小白……小白……”飯飯小聲地叫，小白像是沒聽到。
    大鵰突然動了一下，然後站了起來。被發現了嗎？飯飯的心飛快地跳了起來。他一動不動地看著大鵰，但大鵰沒有往他這邊看。真好，大鵰沒有發現他。
    “晚飯時間到了。”大鵰說。
    他看了看地上的小白，然後跳下石頭，對著小白的腿，咬了一口。
    “啊！”小白疼得大叫一聲。
    大鵰笑了：“我和你玩呢，又不是真的吃你，別害怕。”
    “我不想和你玩，你吃了我吧，我不害怕。”小白說。
    “你不害怕？我不信。以前大白被我抓住的時候，你是多害怕啊，你不記得了嗎？”
    小白不說話了。飯飯看到他的腿、尾巴、頭和身體都被咬過。他一定很疼，所以不能動了。
    “你記得。那你還記得我的翅膀為什麼一邊大一邊小嗎？”大鵰動了動翅膀。
    飯飯看清楚了，大鵰的翅膀真的一邊大一邊小，左邊的大一點兒，右邊的小一點兒。但如果不認真看，是很難發現的。
    小白還是不說話，但他笑了，笑得很大聲。
    “都是因為你！兩年前你咬在我右邊翅膀上的那一口，讓我在家休息了兩個月。如果沒有我爸爸，我可能到今天都還不能飛呢。”大鵰說。
    “我為什麼要咬你？你不知道嗎？”小白問。
    大鵰笑著說：“真的要我說嗎？因為我抓了大白，因為我吃了他啊！”
    小白的頭動了一下，飯飯看到了他的眼睛。
    他的眼睛是紅色的，那裡面有生氣，也有難過。

sentences.traditional: 他一動不動地看著大鵰，但大鵰沒有往他這邊看。真好，大鵰沒有發現他。

sentences.english: He stared motionlessly at the big eagle, but the big eagle did not look his way. Good, the big eagle hadn’t noticed him.

sentences.simplified: “晚饭时间到了。”大雕说。
sentences.traditional: “晚飯時間到了。”大鵰說。
sentences.pinyin: wǎn fàn shí jiān dào le dà diāo shuō
sentences.english: “It’s time for dinner,” the big eagle said.

sentences.simplified: 他看了看地上的小白，然后跳下石头，对着小白的腿，咬了一口。
sentences.traditional: 他看了看地上的小白，然後跳下石頭，對著小白的腿，咬了一口。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le kàn dì shang de xiǎo bái rán hòu tiào xià shí tou duì zhe xiǎo bái de tuǐ yǎo le yì kǒu
sentences.english: He glanced at Little Bai on the ground, then jumped off the rock. He was facing Little Bai’s leg, and he took a bite.

sentences.simplified: “啊！”小白疼得大叫一声。
sentences.traditional: “啊！”小白疼得大叫一聲。
sentences.pinyin: a xiǎo bái téng de dà jiào yì shēng
sentences.english: “Ahh!” Little Bai cried out in pain.

sentences.simplified: 大雕笑了：“我和你玩呢，又不是真的吃你，别害怕。”
sentences.traditional: 大鵰笑了：“我和你玩呢，又不是真的吃你，別害怕。”
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo xiào le wǒ hé nǐ wán ne yòu bú shì zhēn de chī nǐ bié hài pà
sentences.english: The big eagle laughed, “I’m just playing with you. I’m not actually going to eat you. Don’t be scared.”

sentences.simplified: “我不想和你玩，你吃了我吧，我不害怕。”小白说。
sentences.traditional: “我不想和你玩，你吃了我吧，我不害怕。”小白說。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng hé nǐ wán nǐ chī le wǒ ba wǒ bú hài pà xiǎo bái shuō
sentences.english: “I don’t want to play with you. Go ahead and eat me. I’m not scared,” Little Bai said.

sentences.simplified: “你不害怕？我不信。以前大白被我抓住的时候，你是多害怕啊，你不记得了吗？”
sentences.traditional: “你不害怕？我不信。以前大白被我抓住的時候，你是多害怕啊，你不記得了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bú hài pà wǒ bú xìn yǐ qián dà bái bèi wǒ zhuā zhù de shí hou nǐ shì duō hài pà a nǐ bú jì de le ma
sentences.english: “You aren’t scared? I don’t believe that. When Big Bai was taken away by me, you were so scared. Don’t you remember?”

sentences.simplified: 小白不说话了。
sentences.traditional: 小白不說話了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái bù shuō huà le
sentences.english: Little Bai didn’t say anything.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭看到他的腿、尾巴、头和身体都被咬过。他一定很疼，所以不能动了。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯看到他的腿、尾巴、頭和身體都被咬過。他一定很疼，所以不能動了。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn kàn dào tā de tuǐ wěi ba tóu hé shēn tǐ dōu bèi yǎo guò tā yí dìng hěn téng suǒ yǐ bù néng dòng le
sentences.english: Fanfan saw that his legs, tail, head, and body had all been bitten. He must have been in so much pain, so he couldn’t move.

sentences.simplified: “你记得。那你还记得我的翅膀为什么一边大一边小吗？”大雕动了动翅膀。
sentences.traditional: “你記得。那你還記得我的翅膀為什麼一邊大一邊小嗎？”大鵰動了動翅膀。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ jì de nà nǐ hái jì de wǒ de chì bǎng wèi shén me yì biān dà yì biān xiǎo ma dà diāo dòng le dòng chì bǎng
sentences.english: “You remember. Then do you still remember why one of my wings is bigger, and the other is smaller?” The big eagle moved his wings.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭看清楚了，大雕的翅膀真的一边大一边小，
sentences.traditional: 飯飯看清楚了，大鵰的翅膀真的一邊大一邊小，
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn kàn qīng chu le dà diāo de chì bǎng zhēn de yì biān dà yì biān xiǎo
sentences.english: Fanfan saw clearly that the big eagle’s wings were indeed one bigger than the other.

sentences.simplified: 左边的大一点儿，右边的小一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 左邊的大一點兒，右邊的小一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: zuǒ bian de dà yì diǎn'r yòu bian de xiǎo yì diǎn'r
sentences.english: The left one was a bit larger, and the right one was a bit smaller.

sentences.simplified: 但如果不认真看，是很难发现的。
sentences.traditional: 但如果不認真看，是很難發現的。
sentences.pinyin: dàn rú guǒ bú rèn zhēn kàn shì hěn nán fā xiàn de
sentences.english: But if you didn’t look carefully, it would be hard to notice.

sentences.simplified: 小白还是不说话，但他笑了，笑得很大声。
sentences.traditional: 小白還是不說話，但他笑了，笑得很大聲。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái hái shi bù shuō huà dàn tā xiào le xiào de hěn dà shēng
sentences.english: Little Bai still didn’t say anything, but he laughed. He laughed very loudly.

sentences.simplified: “都是因为你！两年前你咬在我右边翅膀上的那一口，让我在家休息了两个月。
sentences.traditional: “都是因為你！兩年前你咬在我右邊翅膀上的那一口，讓我在家休息了兩個月。
sentences.pinyin: dōu shì yīn wèi nǐ liǎng nián qián nǐ yǎo zài wǒ yòu bian chì bǎng shang de nà yì kǒu ràng wǒ zài jiā xiū xi le liǎng ge yuè
sentences.english: “It’s all because of you! The bite you took out of my right wing two years ago made me rest at home for two months.

sentences.simplified: 如果没有我爸爸，我可能到今天都还不能飞呢。”大雕说。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有我爸爸，我可能到今天都還不能飛呢。”大鵰說。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ méi yǒu wǒ bà ba wǒ kě néng dào jīn tiān dōu hái bù néng fēi ne dà diāo shuō
sentences.english: If it weren’t for my dad, I might still not be able to fly today,” the big eagle said.

sentences.simplified: “我为什么要咬你？你不知道吗？”小白问。
sentences.traditional: “我為什麼要咬你？你不知道嗎？”小白問。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ wèi shén me yào yǎo nǐ nǐ bù zhī dào ma xiǎo bái wèn
sentences.english: “Why did I bite you? Don’t you know?” Little Bai asked.

sentences.simplified: 大雕笑着说：“真的要我说吗？因为我抓了大白，因为我吃了他啊！”
sentences.traditional: 大鵰笑著說：“真的要我說嗎？因為我抓了大白，因為我吃了他啊！”
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo xiào zhe shuō zhēn de yào wǒ shuō ma yīn wèi wǒ zhuā le dà bái yīn wèi wǒ chī le tā a
sentences.english: The big eagle smiled and said, “Do you really want me to say? Because I took Big Bai away, because I ate him!”

sentences.simplified: 小白的头动了一下，饭饭看到了他的眼睛。
sentences.traditional: 小白的頭動了一下，飯飯看到了他的眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái de tóu dòng le yí xià fàn fàn kàn dào le tā de yǎn jing
sentences.english: Little Bai’s head moved slightly, and Fanfan saw his eyes.

sentences.simplified: 他的眼睛是红色的，那里面有生气，也有难过。
sentences.traditional: 他的眼睛是紅色的，那裡面有生氣，也有難過。
sentences.pinyin: tā de yǎn jing shì hóng sè de nà lǐ miàn yǒu shēng qì yě yǒu nán guò
sentences.english: His eyes were red. They were filled with both anger and sadness.

sentence_translations: (5) Big Bai
Fanfan found Little Bai in the cave.
Little Bai was sleeping on the ground, and the big eagle was sleeping on the big rock next to him.
“Little Bai … Little Bai …” Fanfan called softly, but it seemed that Little Bai did not hear.
The big eagle suddenly moved and then stood up. Had he been noticed? Fanfan’s heart started to race.
He stared motionlessly at the big eagle, but the big eagle did not look his way. Good, the big eagle hadn’t noticed him.
“It’s time for dinner,” the big eagle said.
He glanced at Little Bai on the ground, then jumped off the rock. He was facing Little Bai’s leg, and he took a bite.
“Ahh!” Little Bai cried out in pain.
The big eagle laughed, “I’m just playing with you. I’m not actually going to eat you. Don’t be scared.”
“I don’t want to play with you. Go ahead and eat me. I’m not scared,” Little Bai said.
“You aren’t scared? I don’t believe that. When Big Bai was taken away by me, you were so scared. Don’t you remember?”
Little Bai didn’t say anything.
Fanfan saw that his legs, tail, head, and body had all been bitten. He must have been in so much pain, so he couldn’t move.
“You remember. Then do you still remember why one of my wings is bigger, and the other is smaller?” The big eagle moved his wings.
Fanfan saw clearly that the big eagle’s wings were indeed one bigger than the other.
The left one was a bit larger, and the right one was a bit smaller.
But if you didn’t look carefully, it would be hard to notice.
Little Bai still didn’t say anything, but he laughed. He laughed very loudly.
“It’s all because of you! The bite you took out of my right wing two years ago made me rest at home for two months.
If it weren’t for my dad, I might still not be able to fly today,” the big eagle said.
“Why did I bite you? Don’t you know?” Little Bai asked.
The big eagle smiled and said, “Do you really want me to say? Because I took Big Bai away, because I ate him!”
Little Bai’s head moved slightly, and Fanfan saw his eyes.
His eyes were red. They were filled with both anger and sadness.
